name: @heymey/dart
description: Turbo wrapper for the Dart pub workspace (root pubspec.yaml). Runs format/analyze/test for mobile, desk and every hm_* package, and regenerates hm_api from the OpenAPI contract.

scripts.lint: cd .. && dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed apps/mobile/lib apps/mobile/test apps/desk/lib apps/desk/test dart/hm_design dart/hm_core dart/hm_data dart/hm_games dart/hm_features dart/hm_desk && flutter analyze && cd dart/hm_api && dart analyze --no-fatal-warnings .
